guard: a compile-time RangeError from a wide but legal schema is renamed to the compiler's generated-code shape and the overflowing width, and the flipped allErrors pin is load-bearing for the raised ceiling
why: #1551: a wide but legal object schema overflows the call stack at compile under the profile's
Ajv pin, and the caller-facing ContractInvalidError named the caller's schema rather than the
compiler's own generated-code shape. The fix catches the RangeError specifically and reports
the shape and the overflowing width instead, and flips allErrors to true (a flat code shape,
measured to change no validation verdict) which raises the same stack-bounded ceiling ~3.4x.

mutations.name: drop the RangeError-specific catch arm so an overflow is reported generically again
mutations.expectRed: the overflow names the compiler's generated-code shape, the overflowing width, and that every profile ceiling had already admitted the schema — not the caller's schema
mutations.cell: the overflow names the compiler's generated-code shape, the overflowing width, and that every profile ceiling had already admitted the schema — not the caller's schema

mutations.name: revert the allErrors pin to false, collapsing the raised ceiling back down
mutations.expectRed: positive control: the smoke's 1000-property width still compiles at the reduced stack budget
mutations.cell: positive control: the smoke's 1000-property width still compiles at the reduced stack budget
